prompt.text:
Implement `scaleDuration(value, fromUnit, toUnit)` and export it as `{ scaleDuration }`.

Supported units are exactly `"milliseconds"`, `"seconds"`, and `"minutes"`. Convert through milliseconds using 1 second = 1000 milliseconds and 1 minute = 60000 milliseconds. `value` must be a finite number; units must be supported strings. Throw `TypeError` otherwise. Negative and fractional durations are valid. Converting between identical units must preserve the numeric value. Normalize a result of negative zero to positive zero.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
